description: Search the AI voice catalog for one language. Each result has a `voice` token (v1:...) - pass it unchanged as `voice` to text_to_speech, multi_voice_to_speech or srt_to_speech. Results are sorted by popularity; `can_use=false` means the user's plan cannot use that voice. Prefer the user's favorite or custom voices when they exist.

language.description: Language code from list_languages, e.g. en, vi, es, ja.

only_usable.description: Hide voices the current plan cannot use.

provider.description: Optional voice engine filter. Gemini/OpenAI voices are the most expressive.

query.description: Optional keywords matched against name, style, persona and use case, e.g. 'warm narrator', 'news', 'young'.

name: list_voices
title: Find voices
